entities.summary: The Arena MRV is a football stadium located in the Brazilian city of Belo Horizonte. The arena belongs to the Clube Atlético Mineiro, which hosts its home games there. With a capacity of 44,892, it is the second-largest football stadium in Belo Horizonte.
